transcript.en: Hello?
transcript.zh: 你好？

transcript.en: Hi, Susie, it's Paul here. How are you?
transcript.zh: 嗨，Susie，我是 Paul. 最近怎么样？

transcript.en: Enjoying your new job?
transcript.zh: 喜欢你的新工作吗？

transcript.en: You're working at the library, aren't you?
transcript.zh: 你是在图书馆工作，是吧？

transcript.en: Yes. I started when the library re-opened a month ago.
transcript.zh: 是的，一个月前图书馆重新开馆时我开始在这工作的，

transcript.en: It's great.
transcript.zh: 图书馆很棒。

transcript.en: Actually Carol and I have been meaning to join for a while.
transcript.zh: 实际上 Carol 和我想来这已经有一段时间了。

transcript.en: Oh, you should.
transcript.zh: 嗯，你们应该来的。

transcript.en: It doesn't cost anything,
transcript.zh: 不需要花钱，

transcript.en: and the new library has all sorts of facilities.
transcript.zh: 而且新图书馆有各种各样的设施。

transcript.en: It's not just a place where you borrow books.
transcript.zh: 它不仅仅是一个借书的地方。

transcript.en: For instance, there's an area with comfortable seats where you can sit and read the magazines they have there.
transcript.zh: 比如说，馆内有一片区域有很舒服的位子可以坐，还可以看那儿的杂志。

transcript.en: Some people spend the whole morning there.
transcript.zh: 有的人整个早上都在那。

transcript.en: Mmm.Wish I had that amount of time to spend!
transcript.zh: 嗯，真希望我也有那么多时间。

transcript.en: Yes. you must be pretty busy at present,
transcript.zh: 哦，你现在一定很忙吧，

transcript.en: with the children and everything?
transcript.zh: 忙着照顾孩子什么的。

transcript.en: We are. yes.
transcript.zh: 嗯，是的。

transcript.en: But we're hoping to get away this summer.
transcript.zh: 不过我们希望这个夏天能出去度假。

transcript.en: We're thinking of going to Greece.
transcript.zh: 我们正考虑去希腊。

transcript.en: Well, we've got a much larger section of the library devoted to travel books now,
transcript.zh: 嗯，我们图书馆用于陈列旅游书籍的部分比以前大了很多，

transcript.en: so you should come and have a look.
transcript.zh: 你可以过来看看。

transcript.en: I can't remember if there's anything specifically on Greece, but I should think so.
transcript.zh: 我不记得有没有专门讲希腊的书，但我想应该有。

transcript.en: OK. Now Carol's organising a project for the history class she teaches at school - It's about life in the town a hundred years ago.
transcript.zh: 好的。Carol 目前正在为她在学校教的历史课组织一个活动，是关于100年前这个城市的生活的。

transcript.en: Do you have anything that might be useful?
transcript.zh: 你那有没有什么有用的资料？

transcript.en: Yes, actually we've now got a new section with materials on the history of the town
transcript.zh: 有的，事实上我们图书馆新开辟了一个部分，用于陈列这座城市及其

transcript.en: and surrounding region.
transcript.zh: 周边区域的历史资料。

transcript.en: Right. I'll tell her.
transcript.zh: 好的，我会告诉她的。

transcript.en: You can't always find that sort of thing on the internet.
transcript.zh: 你在网上不一定能找到那类资料。

transcript.en: Now in the old library there used to be a separate room with reference books.
transcript.zh: 过去，在老图书馆里有一个单独的屋子存放参考书。

transcript.en: It was a really nice quiet room.
transcript.zh: 那真是一个又安静又好的地方。

transcript.en: Yes. We've put those books in the main part of the library now,
transcript.zh: 是的，我们如今把那些书放在图书馆主馆，

transcript.en: but we do have a room called the community room.
transcript.zh: 不过我们现在也有一个叫做社区用室的屋子。

transcript.en: It can be hired out for meetings, but at other times people can use it to study.
transcript.zh: 它可以被租出去用于开会，其他时候人们可以在里面学习。

transcript.en: I might use that.
transcript.zh: 或许我会去那儿学习。

transcript.en: It's hard to find anywhere quiet at home sometimes.
transcript.zh: 有的时候想在家找到个安静的地方很难。

transcript.en: I can't remember how old your son and daughter are ...
transcript.zh: 我不记得你的儿子、女儿多大了。

transcript.en: we've introduced a special section of fiction written specially for teenagers,
transcript.zh: 我们开辟了一个专为青少年写的小说的单元，

transcript.en: but they might be a bit young for that?
transcript.zh: 但他们可能还是小了一点。

transcript.en: Yes, they would be.
transcript.zh: 是的，他们还小。

transcript.en: Well, we do have lots of activities for younger children.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我们有很多针对年纪较小的孩子的活动。

transcript.en: Yes?
transcript.zh: 是吗？

transcript.en: For example we have a Science Club.
transcript.zh: 比如说我们有一个“科学俱乐部”。

transcript.en: At the next meeting,
transcript.zh: 在下一次会议里，

transcript.en: they're going to be doing experiments with stuff that everyone has in the kitchen - sugar and flour and so on.
transcript.zh: 孩子们会利用每家厨房里都有的东西--糖、面粉等做实验。

transcript.en: They might be interested, yes.
transcript.zh: 他们可能会感兴趣，是的。

transcript.en: And we have a competition for children called Reading Challenge.
transcript.zh: 我们还有一个比赛叫做“阅读挑战”。

transcript.en: That doesn't begin until after the end of term.
transcript.zh: 这个比赛要到学期末过后才开始。

transcript.en: They have to read six books, and they get a certificate if they  manage it.
transcript.zh: 他们要读完六本书，如果做到了的话就能得到一个证书。

transcript.en: So that gives them something to do while they're on holiday, instead of getting bored.
transcript.zh: 这样他们假期就有事做而不会无聊了。

transcript.en: That's the idea.
transcript.zh: 嗯，就是这么想的。

transcript.en: And there're special activities for adults too.
transcript.zh: 图书馆也有针对成年人的特别活动。

transcript.en: On Friday we have a local  author called Tanya Streep who's going to be talking about her new novel.
transcript.zh: 星期五，我们邀请了本地作家Tanya Streep来谈谈她的最新小说。

transcript.en: It's called 'Catch the Mouse' and she based the story on a crime that actually took place here  years ago.
transcript.zh: 小说名叫‘Catch the Mouse’，里面的故事是基于一个很多年前在这里发生的一起犯罪事件。

transcript.en: Right. We're not free on Friday,
transcript.zh: 嗯，我们周五没空，

transcript.en: but I'll look out for the book.
transcript.zh: 不过我会找找这本小说。

transcript.en: Now this probably isn't for you,
transcript.zh: 还有一个活动可能不适合你，

transcript.en: but we do have IT support available for members.
transcript.zh: 针对会员我们推出了信息技术支持。

transcript.en: We get quite a few older people coming along who are wanting to get up to speed with computer technology.
transcript.zh: 有不少老人过来，想要跟上电脑技术的发展。

transcript.en: It's on Tuesday mornings - they don't need to make an appointment or anything, they just turn up.
transcript.zh: 这个活动是在星期二上午，他们不需要事先约定，到时候自然就来了。

transcript.en: Well, my mother might be interested, I'll let her know.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我母亲或许会感兴趣，我会告诉她的。

transcript.en: OK.And there's another service which you wouldn't expect from a library,
transcript.zh: 好。还有一个活动你可能想不到图书馆会有，

transcript.en: which is a free medical check-up.
transcript.zh: 那就是免费的医疗检查。

transcript.en: The hospital arranges for someone to come along and  measure the level of sugar in your blood,
transcript.zh: 医院安排了人过来，可以测血糖，

transcript.en: and they check cholesterol levels at the same time.
transcript.zh: 同时他们还会检测胆固醇水平。

transcript.en: Really?
transcript.zh: 真的吗？

transcript.en: Yes,but that's only for the over-60s, so you wouldn't qualify.
transcript.zh: 是的，不过这项服务仅提供给60岁以上的人，所以你不能参与。

transcript.en: OK. Well, I'll tell my mother, she might be interested.
transcript.zh: 好的，我会告诉我妈，她也许会有兴趣。

transcript.en: What other information…
transcript.zh: 至于别的什么信息...

transcript.en: well, we do have a little shop with things like wallcharts and greetings cards,
transcript.zh: 哦，我们还有一个小商店卖挂图、贺卡之类的东西，

transcript.en: and also stamps so you can post the cards straightaway, which is really useful.
transcript.zh: 还有邮票，很有用，你可以在那直接把卡片寄出去。

transcript.en: Yeah. Well, I'll bring the children round at the weekend and we'll join.
transcript.zh: 好的，周末我会带孩子们过来，我们要加入进来。

transcript.en: Oh, one more thing - I'll be bringing the car, is there parking available?
transcript.zh: 哦，还有一件事，我会开车过来，图书馆有停车的地方吗？

transcript.en: Yes, and it's free in the evening and at weekends.
transcript.zh: 有的，而且在晚上和周末免费。

transcript.en: Perfect.Well, thanks, Susie see you…
transcript.zh: 完美。好的，谢谢你，Susie. 再见...
